text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 宫廷东廊.
Environment: Pearl-white sea-palace east gallery, repeating arches, slim columns, pale blue tidal channels and sea views.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent multi-angle image sheet with 2 clearly separated views of the same location. Show complementary eye-level views and relevant close details. Maintain the same physical positions of entrances, windows, stairs, furniture and landmark objects across views; no mirrored rearrangement. Small A/B/C/D labels only.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create TWO stacked wide views using only A and D of this reference. A looks along the gallery toward the seaward open end, water windows at LEFT, solid ornate wall RIGHT. B reverse direction toward blue closed door, water windows RIGHT, solid ornate wall LEFT. No mirroring or moving walls. Same blue gold white palace corridor, no characters.
